title: Identifying and Adapting Transformer-Components Responsible for Gender Bias in an English Language Model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's preference for stereotypical versus anti-stereotypical sentences by comparing the probabilities (or perplexities) assigned to gendered pronoun continuations using contrastive minimal pair datasets like WinoBias, the gender subset of CrowS-Pairs, and the Professions dataset.
